instruction:
Task: Click the sidebar toggle button (located at the bottom right of the sidebar).
Expected Result: The sidebar's persistent state switches: if it was set to 'expanded', it transitions to a 'collapsed' state (e.g., narrow, icons only). If it was set to 'collapsed', it transitions to an 'expanded' state (i.e., full width, showing content) and remains expanded irrespective of hover.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The sidebar's persistent state switches: if it was set to 'expanded', it transitions to a 'collapsed' state (e.g., narrow, icons only). If it was set to 'collapsed', it transitions to an 'expanded' state (i.e., full width, showing content) and remains expanded irrespective of hover.
